name: lbm_channel_timing
description: Timing workload grid for cross-architecture normalisation. Numerical kernel only: D2Q9 BGK channel flow. The grid is a crossed design (cells x steps) so that the log-linear feature model is identifiable -- a non-crossed grid makes log10(cells) and log10(steps) collinear and the fitted coefficients uninterpretable. Roles: calibration workloads are used to estimate alpha (same code on every arm), evaluation workloads are held out to measure the residual difference.
